findings.inefficiency: The updater queries every details subtree for all anchors, then discards descendant-group anchors using closest(). Every module anchor has already been classified for the whole-tree count at lines 45-48, and is classified again at line 54. Ancestor groups additionally allocate and scan the same descendant anchor lists before discarding them. This repeats on every astro:page-load.
findings.concreteFix: During the existing per-navigation anchor pass, classify each link once, update the department course sets, and collect each non-null identity.department into a Map keyed by link.closest(details). Then iterate details and read that map to identify single-department groups. Keep counts scoped to the full navigation tree, retain zero-course department indexes, and retain the exact single-department guard. This removes repeated subtree queries and classification without changing rendered navigation or its size.
evidence: src/scripts/streeling-nav-counts.mjs:45-48 counts all navigation anchors using streelingLinkIdentity through countDepartmentCourses.
